Supabase's main skill, loaded for any task that touches Supabase. It covers the CLI and MCP server, schema changes and migrations, auth and session handling in SSR frameworks, row-level security, storage policies, edge functions and debugging. It stresses security points such as which RLS policies each operation needs. Reference guides and assets are bundled.

**Try asking:**
- "Add Supabase auth to my Next.js app with SSR"
- "Write RLS policies so users only see their own rows"
